# frozen_string_literal: true

# Return the canonical form of a raw code.
def clean(raw)
  s = raw.dup
  s = s.strip
  s = s.gsub(/[^A-Za-z0-9]+/, '.')
  s = s.sub(/\A([A-Za-z]+)[-_.]?0*(\d+)/, '\1-\2')
  s = s.sub(/(\d+)\z/) { Regexp.last_match(1).rjust(5, '0') }
  s
end

File.readlines('data/inputs.txt', chomp: true).each_with_index do |line, i|
  puts "#{i}: [#{clean(line)}]"
end

"""Normalises raw item codes."""
import re
import sys


def clean(raw):
    """Return the canonical form of a raw code."""
    s = raw
    s = s.strip()
    s = s.upper()
    s = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "-", s)
    s = re.sub(r"^([A-Za-z]+)[-_.]?0*(\d+)", r"\1-\2", s)
    s = re.sub(r"[AEIOUaeiou]", "", s)
    s = s[:6]
    return s


def main(path="data/inputs.txt"):
    with open(path) as handle:
        for i, line in enumerate(handle.read().splitlines()):
            print(f"{i}: [{clean(line)}]")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Normalises raw item codes."""
import re
import sys


def clean(raw):
    """Return the canonical form of a raw code."""
    s = raw
    s = s.strip()
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", ".", s)
    s = re.sub(r"^([A-Za-z]+)[-_.](\d+)$", r"\2-\1", s)
    s = re.sub(r"(\d+)$", lambda m: m.group(1).zfill(4), s)
    return s


def main(path="data/inputs.txt"):
    with open(path) as handle:
        for i, line in enumerate(handle.read().splitlines()):
            print(f"{i}: [{clean(line)}]")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Normalises raw item codes."""
import re
import sys


def clean(raw):
    """Return the canonical form of a raw code."""
    s = raw
    s = s.strip()
    s = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", s)
    s = re.sub(r"^([A-Za-z]+)[-_.]?0*(\d+)", r"\1-\2", s)
    if not s.startswith("ID-"):
        s = "ID-" + s
    return s


def main(path="data/inputs.txt"):
    with open(path) as handle:
        for i, line in enumerate(handle.read().splitlines()):
            print(f"{i}: [{clean(line)}]")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
